mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalSkills, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN enable_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS enabledSkills, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN enable_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disabledSkills, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN featured = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS featuredSkills, COALESCE(SUM(total_uses), 0) AS totalUses, COALESCE(SUM(weekly_uses), 0) AS weeklyUses, COALESCE(SUM(total_uses * price), 0) AS totalEarnings, COALESCE(SUM(weekly_earnings), 0) AS weeklyEarnings, COALESCE(SUM(milestone_bonus), 0) AS milestoneBonus FROM u_skill_market WHERE is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.skill_name AS skillName, u.nickname AS publisherName, s.publisher_user_id AS publisherUserId, s.total_uses AS totalUses, s.weekly_uses AS weeklyUses, s.weekly_earnings AS weeklyEarnings, s.milestone_bonus AS milestoneBonus FROM u_skill_market s LEFT JOIN u_user u ON u.id = s.publisher_user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY s.total_uses DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT s.publisher_user_id AS publisherUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.email) AS publisherName, COUNT(*) AS skillCount, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_uses), 0) AS totalUses, COALESCE(SUM(s.weekly_earnings), 0) AS weeklyEarnings FROM u_skill_market s LEFT JOIN u_user u ON u.id = s.publisher_user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.publisher_user_id ORDER BY weeklyEarnings DESC, s.publisher_user_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(t.completed_at) AS date, COUNT(*) AS uses, COALESCE(SUM(s.price), 0) AS earnings FROM a_generation_task t LEFT JOIN u_skill_market s ON s.biz_no = t.skill_ref AND s.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 2 AND t.skill_ref IS NOT NULL AND t.completed_at >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(t.completed_at) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT t.target_user_id AS userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.email) AS userNickname, t.biz_no AS taskBizNo, t.article_biz_no AS articleBizNo, t.completed_at AS completedAt FROM a_generation_task t LEFT JOIN u_user u ON u.id = t.target_user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 2 AND t.skill_ref = #{skillRef} ORDER BY t.completed_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM a_generation_task t WHERE t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.status = 2 AND t.skill_ref = #{skillRef}
